q.q: Which OpenShift resource exposes an application through a unique, publicly accessible host name, with the Ingress Controller forwarding traffic to the pods?
q.e: Route 讓應用程式擁有唯一、可公開存取的 Host 名稱，由 Ingress Controller 把流量導到應用程式的 Pod。

q.q: Which methods can expose HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, and non-TCP traffic to external networks?
q.e: NodePort 與 LoadBalancer 屬 Service 類型，可處理 HTTP、HTTPS、TCP 與非 TCP 流量；Ingress 主要用於 HTTP 與 HTTPS。

q.q: On ROSA and OpenShift Dedicated, how can a private cluster expose applications while the cluster itself stays private?
o: Through a second, public Ingress Controller that creates a cloud-native load balancer at the internet edge
By converting the cluster to public mode
q.e: 私有 Cluster 可透過第二個對外的 Ingress Controller 暴露應用程式，它在網際網路邊緣建立雲端原生的 Load Balancer，Cluster 本身仍維持私有。

q.q: Which TLS termination type is the default for encrypted routes?
q.e: Edge 為預設類型：TLS 在 Router 終止，再把流量送到 Pod。

q.q: With an edge route, which part of the connection is NOT encrypted?
o: The connection from the router to the pod
The connection from the client to the router
q.e: Edge 模式下 Client 到 Router 是加密的，TLS 在 Router 終止，Router 到 Pod 的內部連線沒有加密。

q.q: With which route termination type does the router NOT terminate TLS and instead forward encrypted traffic directly to the pod?
q.e: Passthrough 的 Router 不終止 TLS，加密流量直接送到 Pod，由應用程式提供憑證並解密。

q.q: Which route termination type can provide mutual authentication between the application and the client?
q.e: Passthrough 由應用程式自己處理 TLS，可提供應用程式與 Client 之間的雙向驗證。

q.q: Which route termination type terminates TLS at the router and then encrypts a new connection to the pod, possibly with a different certificate?
q.e: Re-encrypt 是 Edge 的變化，Router 終止 TLS 後再重新加密連到 Pod，Pod 可使用不同憑證，整條路徑都加密，安全性最高。

q.q: What is required to create an encrypted route?
o: A key and certificate, and a TLS termination type
q.e: 加密的 Route 需要設定 Key 與憑證，並指定 TLS 終止類型；不加密的 Route 則不需要 Key 與憑證。

q.q: In 'oc create route edge --service api-frontend --hostname api.apps.acme.com --key api.key --cert api.crt', what does --key provide?
o: The private key of the certificate
q.e: --key 需要憑證的私鑰，--cert 需要簽署過的憑證。

q.q: If you omit --key and --cert when creating an edge route, what happens?
o: The Ingress Operator provides a certificate from an internal CA, and the route references a Secret that contains it
The route is created as an unencrypted route
The application must provide the certificate
q.e: 省略 --key 與 --cert 時，Ingress Operator 以內部 Certificate Authority 提供憑證，Route 改為參照含該憑證的 Secret。

q.q: What happens if you run 'oc create route' with --dry-run=server?
o: The route is still created, because create route does not support server dry-run
The route is validated and not created
The command fails with an error
Only the TLS Secret is created
q.e: create route 不支援 --dry-run=server，即使指定仍會真的建立 Route；只想產生 Manifest 時要用 --dry-run=client。

q.q: For a passthrough route, how can the application access its certificate?
o: Store the certificate as a TLS Secret and mount it into the container as a volume
Reference it in the route's --cert option
Store it in the router's configuration
Download it from the Ingress Operator at startup
q.e: Passthrough 需要讓應用程式存取憑證，常見做法是存為 TLS Secret，再以 Volume Mount 到 Container。

q.q: Which command creates a TLS Secret named todo-certs?
o: oc create secret tls todo-certs --cert training.crt --key training.key
oc create secret generic todo-certs --tls training.crt
q.e: oc create secret tls NAME --cert FILE --key FILE 建立 TLS Secret。

q.q: For a re-encrypt route, which certificate does the router use toward the internal service?
o: A service certificate that contains the OpenShift internal FQDN, which the service-ca controller can issue
The same public certificate that the client trusts
No certificate; the internal connection is plain text
q.e: Re-encrypt 先以 Client 信任的 FQDN 憑證終止外部連線，再以含 OpenShift 內部 FQDN 的服務憑證重新加密連到 Service，可由 service-ca controller 簽發。

q.q: In the guided exercise, a debug pod accesses the passthrough application over HTTP at the service level. What is the result?
q.e: 部署 v1.2 版本後，Debug Pod 以 HTTP 存取會得到 301，轉向 HTTPS。

q.q: By default, which pods can reach a pod in a project?
o: Other pods, VMs, and endpoints in the cluster, including pods in other namespaces
Only pods in the same project
No pods until a NetworkPolicy allows it
q.e: 預設不隔離：Project 中的 Pod 與 VM 可被 Cluster 內其他 Pod、VM 與 Endpoint 存取，不同 Namespace 之間也能互相連線。

q.q: How does a NetworkPolicy identify the traffic to control?
o: By labels rather than IP addresses
q.e: 與傳統防火牆不同，Network Policy 以 Label 而非 IP 位址識別要控制的流量。

q.q: Do developers need administrator privileges to create NetworkPolicy resources in their projects?
o: No; they can set isolation policies for their own pods without administrator rights
Yes; only cluster-admin can create them
Yes; they need the cluster-reader role
q.e: Network Policy 可設定個別 Pod 的隔離政策，不需要管理員權限，開發者可自行控制 Project 裡的應用程式。

q.q: Which traffic is NOT blocked by NetworkPolicy?
o: Traffic from host-networked pods to pods on the same node
Traffic between pods in different namespaces
Traffic from the router on a different node
q.e: Network Policy 不會阻擋使用 Host Networking 的 Pod 對同一 Node 上 Pod 的流量，例如單一 Node Cluster 的 Ingress Pod。

q.q: Who defines AdminNetworkPolicy resources, and can namespace users override them?
o: Cluster administrators; namespace users cannot override them
Namespace administrators; anyone can override them
Developers; only cluster administrators can override them
The Ingress Operator; they are read-only
q.e: AdminNetworkPolicy (ANP) 由 Cluster 管理員定義，強制執行 Cluster 範圍的規則，各 Namespace 的使用者無法覆寫。

q.q: What is the purpose of BaselineAdminNetworkPolicy (BANP)?
o: To define baseline rules that namespace users can override
To define rules that nobody can override
To replace NetworkPolicy in each namespace
q.e: BANP 由 Cluster 管理員定義基準規則，各 Namespace 的使用者可以覆寫。簡報註明 BANP 不在本課程範圍內。

q.q: In which order does OVN-Kubernetes evaluate network policy tiers?
o: ANP in tier 1, NetworkPolicy in tier 2, BANP in tier 3
NetworkPolicy in tier 1, ANP in tier 2, BANP in tier 3
BANP in tier 1, ANP in tier 2, NetworkPolicy in tier 3
All policies are evaluated at the same time
q.e: OVN-Kubernetes 以 ACL Tier 評估：Tier 1 為 ANP、Tier 2 為 NP、Tier 3 為 BANP。

q.q: Why can a developer create a NetworkPolicy that allows traffic blocked by a BaselineAdminNetworkPolicy?
o: BANP is evaluated only for egress
Developers have priority over cluster administrators
q.e: 第二層 NP 先於第三層 BANP 評估，所以開發者可以放行被基準政策擋下的流量；但無法覆寫 ANP 在第一層定義的拒絕規則。

q.q: Traffic matches an AdminNetworkPolicy Deny rule in tier 1. What happens to the NetworkPolicy rules in the namespace?
o: They are skipped; the traffic is denied
They are evaluated and can allow the traffic
They are merged with the ANP rule
q.e: 流量符合 ANP 規則時直接依規則允許或拒絕，既有的 NetworkPolicy 規則會被略過；只有沒有符合或符合 Pass 規則時才進入第二層。

q.q: Multiple NetworkPolicies select the same pod. How is the allowed traffic determined?
o: Policies are additive: the allowed traffic is the union of all matching policies
The policies conflict and all traffic is blocked
q.e: 多個 Network Policy 可套用到同一 Pod，且具累加性，允許的流量是所有符合政策的聯集。

q.q: What does a NetworkPolicy with 'podSelector: {}' and no ingress rules do?
o: Blocks all ingress traffic to every pod in the project
Allows all traffic to every pod
q.e: 這就是 default-deny 政策：空的 podSelector 套用到 Project 內所有 Pod，沒有定義 ingress 規則，因此封鎖所有進入的流量。

q.q: A pod is not selected by any NetworkPolicy. How is its traffic treated?
o: OpenShift does not restrict its traffic
q.e: Pod 若不符合任何 Network Policy，OpenShift 就不會限制它的流量；因此要建立只允許明確放行流量的環境，必須包含拒絕所有流量的政策。

q.q: Before a NetworkPolicy can allow traffic from another namespace by using a namespaceSelector, what is usually required?
o: Label the source namespace, because namespaces do not have such labels by default
Create a route in the source namespace
Grant cluster-admin to the source namespace
q.e: 先以 oc label namespace 為需要存取的 Namespace 加上 Label，再建立選取該 Label 的政策；練習中也提到 Namespace 預設不會有 Label。

q.q: In a NetworkPolicy spec, which field is required and determines which pods the policy applies to?
q.e: 頂層 podSelector 必填，決定哪些 Pod 使用此政策；ingress.from 定義來源，ports 為允許到達所選 Pod 的目的 Port。

q.q: In a NetworkPolicy, what do the entries under 'ports' specify?
o: The destination ports that are allowed to reach the selected pods
The source ports of the client
q.e: ports 是允許到達所選 Pod 的目的 Port，例如 port: 8080、protocol: TCP。

q.q: In a from list, namespaceSelector and podSelector appear in the same list item. How are they combined?
q.e: 合併在同一個物件時條件以 AND 組合，例如只允許 network=dev Namespace 中 app=mobile 的 Pod。

q.q: In a from list, namespaceSelector and podSelector appear as two separate list items. Which sources are allowed?
o: Any pod in the matching namespace, or any pod with the matching label in any namespace
Only pods that match both selectors
Only pods in the policy's own namespace
q.e: 分成清單中的多個物件時條件以 OR 組合：network=dev Namespace 的任何 Pod，或任何 Namespace 中 app=mobile 的 Pod。兩者只差在縮排與清單寫法，要特別小心。

q.q: After securing pods with a deny-all NetworkPolicy on a multi-node cluster, why might routes stop working?
o: Router pods need an explicit policy, such as allow-from-openshift-ingress, to reach the application pods
q.e: 提供外部存取的 Router Pod 需要明確的政策才能存取被保護的 Pod，例如 allow-from-openshift-ingress；練習也提到多 Node Cluster 需要此政策。

q.q: Which namespace label does the allow-from-openshift-ingress policy select?
q.e: 範例政策的 namespaceSelector 選取 policy-group.network.openshift.io/ingress: ""；Monitoring 政策則改選 network.openshift.io/policy-group: monitoring。

q.q: When does an application namespace need a NetworkPolicy that allows the monitoring service?
o: When the application provides a metrics endpoint
q.e: 當應用程式提供 Metrics Endpoint 時，Monitoring 服務需要明確的政策才能存取被保護的 Pod。

q.q: Starting with RHOCP 4.22, what do the operators that manage cluster DNS and ingress do in namespaces such as openshift-dns and openshift-ingress?
o: Automatically install deny-all policies that you should not modify
q.e: 從 RHOCP 4.22 起，這些 Operator 會自動安裝 deny-all 政策；請勿修改，也不要在這些 Namespace 執行自訂 Pod，否則流量會被封鎖。

q.q: What is the API group and version of AdminNetworkPolicy in the course example?
q.e: ANP 的 API group 為 policy.networking.k8s.io/v1alpha1；一般 NetworkPolicy 則是 networking.k8s.io/v1。

q.q: How does the priority field of an AdminNetworkPolicy work?
o: Lower values are evaluated first, in the range 0 to 99
Higher values are evaluated first, in the range 1 to 1000
Priority is ignored when action is Deny
q.e: priority 決定套用順序，數值小者先評估，範圍 0 到 99；管理員要謹慎指派，避免非預期的覆寫。

q.q: In an AdminNetworkPolicy, what does 'subject: namespaces: {}' mean?
o: The policy applies to the entire cluster
The policy applies to no namespaces
The policy applies only to the default namespace
The policy applies only to openshift-* namespaces
q.e: subject 指定套用的 Namespace；空的 namespaces 選擇器代表整個 Cluster。

q.q: Which requirement applies to every rule in an AdminNetworkPolicy?
o: Each rule must have a name
Each rule must specify a port
Each rule must use action Allow
Each rule must include a podSelector
q.e: 簡報指出 ANP 規則必須有 name，例如 deny-untrusted-ingress、allow-db-egress。

q.q: In an AdminNetworkPolicy egress rule, which field selects destinations outside the cluster by CIDR block?
q.e: egress 規則以 networks 用 CIDR 區塊選取 Cluster 外的對象，例如 10.0.0.0/24，並以 portNumber 比對 Port 與協定。

q.q: According to the course, what is true about application traffic in OpenShift by default?
o: It is not encrypted, and applications do not necessarily verify each other
It is always encrypted with mTLS
It is encrypted only within the same node
q.e: OpenShift 預設加密 Node 與 Control Plane 之間的流量，但應用程式流量預設不加密，應用程式也不一定驗證彼此。

q.q: Which post-quantum capability does RHOCP 4.22 support for TLS 1.3 connections?
q.e: RHOCP 4.22 在 TLS 1.3 連線支援混合式 ML-KEM Key Exchange，可於 API Server、Ingress Controller 等元件設定 Modern TLS Security Profile 啟用。

q.q: What trade-off does the course mention for post-quantum cryptography in RHOCP 4.22?
o: It is currently incompatible with FIPS 140 validated cryptography
It doubles the certificate validity period
q.e: 所有 PQC 機制都需要 TLS 1.3 以上，目前與 FIPS 140 驗證的密碼學不相容，需要在 FIPS 合規與 PQC 保護之間取捨。

q.q: Which annotation on a Service makes the service-ca controller generate a signed certificate and key?
q.e: 在 Service 套用 service.beta.openshift.io/serving-cert-secret-name=SECRET，Controller 就在同一 Namespace 建立含 tls.crt 與 tls.key 的 Secret。

q.q: How does a client application obtain the CA bundle needed to verify service certificates?
o: Annotate a dedicated ConfigMap with service.beta.openshift.io/inject-cabundle=true and mount it in the client pod
Copy the router-ca Secret manually into every pod
q.e: 對 ConfigMap 加上 inject-cabundle=true Annotation，Controller 會把 CA Bundle 寫入 data 中的 service-ca.crt，再 Mount 到 Client Pod 供驗證 Server 憑證。

q.q: Why should you use a dedicated ConfigMap for CA bundle injection?
o: The controller replaces all data in the selected ConfigMap
The controller deletes the ConfigMap after injection
Only empty ConfigMaps can be mounted
The ConfigMap must be in openshift-config
q.e: service-ca controller 會取代所選 ConfigMap 的所有資料，請使用專用 ConfigMap，避免覆寫既有資料。

q.q: How long is the service CA certificate valid by default, and when is it rotated automatically?
o: 26 months; it is rotated when less than 13 months of validity remain
12 months; it is rotated after 6 months
90 days; it is rotated after 60 days
q.e: Service CA 憑證預設有效 26 個月，有效期低於 13 個月時自動輪替；輪替後 13 個月內原憑證仍有效，期間需重新啟動信任原憑證的 Pod。

q.q: How do you manually rotate a service certificate generated by the service-ca controller?
o: Delete the Secret that contains the certificate; the controller generates a new one
q.e: 刪除含該憑證的 Secret，Controller 會自動產生新的 Secret。若刪除 openshift-service-ca 中的 signing-key Secret 則會輪替 Service CA 本身，並立即使舊憑證失效。
